cardOverview.overviewText: A premium card featuring 5x Membership Rewards points on travel and dining spends, complimentary lounge access, and milestone rewards worth ₹50,000 annually. Cardholders also enjoy concierge services and exclusive access to global Amex Offers.

benefitRows.name: Accor Plus
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Accor Plus membership, check your email for the activation link and membership number. Visit the Accor Plus activation page, enter your membership number and registered email, and follow the prompts to activate. Download the Accor ALL app and log in to access your digital membership card and benefits.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Platinum Concierge offers a variety of services, including the delivery of flowers and gifts to someone special, booking movie tickets, arranging a round of golf, or even booking a rejuvenating spa session at participating partners. Additionally, they can assist with making dining reservations, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Please call Platinum Concierge Services on 0124-6736660/ 1800-419-1030 (Toll free from MTNL, BSNL landlines) - press option 1 for Card Assistance or 3 for Concierge
